text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash is garnering attention from the audience, but only by default because of the other racers in the current roster.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, this fact doesn't seem to bother Eishin Flash, as she's already looking ahead to the Satsuki Sho.
